name: Finnmark FD-1 Full Spectrum 1-Person Infrared Sauna
description: Finnmark FD-1 Full Spectrum Infrared Sauna, 38”W x 38”D x 78”H Elevate your wellness routine with the Finnmark FD-1 Full Spectrum Infrared Sauna, a compact oasis designed for personal rejuvenation. Uniquely crafted, it stands out in the industry by seamlessly integrating UL Listed Spectrum Plus™ infrared heaters with Spectrum Carbon 360°, ensuring you achieve a blissful sweat at temperatures up to 170° in under an hour using a standard home outlet. Finnmark Design's commitment to quality and craftsmanship outshines the competition. Immerse yourself in the sauna's antimicrobial Western Canadian cedar interior, fending off mold, bacteria, and fungus to maintain a pristine environment free from unpleasant odors. The Thermal Plus™ Aspen exterior, treated organically with heat and steam, guarantees durability, resisting rot, warp, decay, or chipping. Finnmark Designs' full spectrum IR saunas boast a longevity that sets them apart. What makes Finnmark Designs unparalleled is the fusion of long-wave carbon 360 infrared panels with UL-listed short-wave Spectrum Plus™ infrared panels. This strategic combination ensures higher temperatures, complete body coverage, deeper penetration, and an unparalleled sweating experience. Spectrum Plus™ heaters, UL-listed and boasting short-wave technology, deliver deep penetrating heat, outperforming standard carbon panel heaters up to 25 times. The synergy of Spectrum Carbon long-wave infrared heaters and Spectrum LED near-infrared ceiling lights, coupled with medical-grade color therapy, creates an immersive and therapeutic sauna experience beyond compare. Elevate your well-being with Finnmark Designs - where quality meets innovation. Features Antimicrobial Western Canadian cedar interior that protects against mold, bacteria, and fungus. Thermal Plus™ Aspen exterior that will never rot, warp, decay, or chip. Making Finnmark Designs full spectrum infrared saunas one of the healthiest and longest-lasting saunas on the market. Finnmark Designs is the only infrared sauna manufacturer that combines long-wave carbon 360 infrared panels with UL-listed short-wave Spectrum Plus™ infrared panels. This combination provides higher temperatures, full body coverage, deeper penetration, and an experience better than any other sauna. Each heater is strategically placed to offer the highest level of therapy possible. Built-in LCD touchscreen controller with Bluetooth audio. Audio with 6" HiFi speakers, and 8mm tempered glass for the ultimate thermal retention. Ergonomic backrest for comfort Removable and adjustable sauna feet for uneven surfaces. Low EMF sauna tested by a NASA award-winning testing facility. High Emissivity infrared heaters High-quality double-walled construction with non-toxic wool insulation. Over 15,000 Sold Health Benefits Benefits of Infrared The technology of the Spectrum Plus incoloy heaters warms your core body temperature, producing a cleaner, healthier sweat while lowering blood pressure, and maintaining heart health. The natural heat produced by the Spectrum Plus heaters is designed to achieve a more controlled hot climate, much like a traditional sauna, without the unbearable heat temperatures. This deeper penetration through sweating goes beyond the muscle and fat rather than a traditional or hot air sauna. As a result, you're able to work up the best possible sweat in the least amount of time. Spectrum Plus heaters remove 17% more toxins such as cholesterol, fat-soluble toxins, toxic heavy metals, sulfuric acid, sodium, ammonia, and uric acid. Full Spectrum Sauna combination of long-wave Spectrum Carbon 360 infrared panels with UL-listed short-wave Spectrum Plus™ infrared panels. This combination provides higher temperatures, full body coverage, deeper penetration, and a better experience than any other sauna. Reap the benefits of a more natural pain relief remedy with every infrared sauna session. Athletes can appreciate a faster muscle recovery with increased blood flow to the muscles, delivering more concentrated oxygen and creating more energy to heal.
